description: This is a Request for Information (RFI) for market research and planning purposes only. Responding is not a prerequisite for any future solicitation. The purpose of this RFI is to identify potential contractors with experience in updating Supplemental Type Certificates for Bombardier Global 6000 and Global XRS aircraft along with planning, integration, and testing required to meet Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and USAF airworthiness requirements. Further details can be found in the attached RFI letter.
